metric_definition: Live reference-Pin observation (see reference_ids on this candidate): generic 'tallow soap'/'handmade soap' search on Pinterest is dominated by DIY recipe/tutorial pins (how to make it yourself), not finished-product listings. The 'soap gifts' query surfaces genuine commercial/gift-set framing instead -- e.g. a directly comparable competitor 'Tallow Soap Gift Set' (bamboo rack + bag), a bath/body gift set, and a soap-packaging-inspiration pin. Combined with the earlier editorial finding that video pins under 30s get ~6.2x the CTR and ~4.8x the save rate of static pins, and that ~85% of viewers watch muted. Not a numeric demand series for this keyword.
